summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Run “Kafka repartition offset migration” in between other work, steps 1–9 in order, one at a time.
- Carry on while operator attends a meeting.
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Forget the tracing work for now.
- Fix Canadian Quebec QST tax calculation in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py` first.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`; `orders.v1` (6 partitions), `orders.v2` (12); groups `orders-v1`, `orders-v2`; offsets `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`; reassignment `/var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`; config `/etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`. Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` superseded, do not use. `args.filters["currency"]` superseded by `args.currency`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to 6 hours: stuck jobs remain invisible for hours.
- Per-invoice embedding calls: slower; use bounded concurrent batching.
- OpenTelemetry work: deferred by operator.

## Plan and progress
Kafka steps 1–3 done; 4–9 pending. Exact next command was not recorded. Search tenant scoping, shared embedder, bulk upsert, and index migration are done; full suite passed. CSV encoding and regression tests passed, but privacy-review/approval was not observed. Quebec QST fix is pending.

## Recent work
Search rebuild improved from 16.73s to 2.41s median. CSV output now explicitly UTF-8; 8 tests pass. `ledgerly/customer_export/` must not be changed further without approval.
